cases.translation: A green icon-lamp burns before the icon.
cases.explain: «Лампадка» is the grammatical subject of «горит», so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Через всю комнату от угла до ___ тянется веревка, на которой висят пеленки и большие черные панталоны.
cases.translation: A rope stretches across the whole room from corner to corner, on which hang diapers and large black trousers.
cases.explain: The preposition «до» (to/as far as) governs the genitive case, giving «угла».

cases.sentence: Мать Пелагея побежала в усадьбу, ___ сказать, что Ефим помирает.
cases.translation: Mother Pelageya ran to the manor house to tell the masters that Yefim is dying.
cases.explain: The verb «сказать (кому)» takes an indirect object in the dative case, giving «господам».

cases.sentence: Ей приятно и щекотно от мысли, что она сейчас избавится от ребенка, сковывающего ее по рукам и ногам, убить ___, а потом спать, спать, спать.
cases.translation: It is pleasant and ticklish to her, the thought that she will soon be rid of the child binding her hand and foot — to kill the child, and then sleep, sleep, sleep.
cases.explain: «Ребёнка» is the direct object of «убить» (to kill); as an animate masculine noun its accusative form matches the genitive.

cases.translation: A false idea takes hold of Varka.
cases.explain: The verb «овладевать (кем-чем)» governs the instrumental case without a preposition, giving «Варькой».

cases.sentence: Мурлычет варька и уже видит себя в темной душной ___.
cases.translation: Varka purrs her lullaby and already sees herself in a dark, stuffy peasant hut.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» marking location governs the prepositional case here, giving «избе».

reading.ru: нянька варька девочка лет 13 качает колыбель который лежит ребенок и чуть слышно мурлычет и Баю, баюшки, баю, а я песенку спою.
reading.question: Who is Varka and what is she doing at the start of the story?
options: A 13-year-old nursemaid rocking a cradle and humming a lullaby
A grown woman singing at a party
A mother rocking her own baby
reading.correct: A 13-year-old nursemaid rocking a cradle and humming a lullaby
reading.explain: Varka is introduced as a 13-year-old nursemaid rocking the cradle and quietly humming a lullaby.

reading.ru: Он давно уже осип и изнемог от плача.
reading.question: What has happened to the baby from all its crying?
options: It has grown hoarse and exhausted
reading.correct: It has grown hoarse and exhausted
reading.explain: The baby has long since grown hoarse and worn out from crying, yet still cries on.

reading.ru: А Варьке хочется спать.
reading.question: What is Varka's overwhelming feeling throughout the story?
reading.correct: She wants to sleep
reading.explain: The recurring theme of the story is that Varka desperately wants to sleep.

reading.ru: В соседней комнате за дверью похрапывает хозяин и подмастерье Афанасий.
reading.question: Who is snoring in the next room?
options: The master and the apprentice Afanasy
reading.correct: The master and the apprentice Afanasy
reading.explain: Behind the door in the next room, the master and the apprentice Afanasy are snoring.

reading.ru: Если Варька, не дай бог, уснет, то хозяева прибьют ее.
reading.question: What will happen if Varka falls asleep?
reading.correct: Her employers will beat her
reading.explain: The text warns that if Varka falls asleep, God forbid, her employers will beat her.

reading.ru: Но вот подул ветер, пропали облака, и Варька видит широкое шоссе, покрытое жидкой грязью.
reading.question: What does Varka see in her half-asleep vision after the clouds disappear?
options: A wide highway covered in liquid mud
reading.correct: A wide highway covered in liquid mud
reading.explain: After the wind blows the clouds away, Varka sees a wide highway covered in liquid mud.

reading.ru: У него, как он говорит, разыгралась грыжа.
reading.question: What ailment does Varka's father Yefim suffer from in her memory/vision?
reading.correct: A hernia flaring up
reading.explain: Yefim says that his hernia has flared up, causing him great pain.

reading.ru: Это господа прислали молодого доктора, который приехал к ним из города в гости.
reading.question: Who do the masters send to help the dying Yefim?
options: A young doctor who was visiting them from the city
reading.correct: A young doctor who was visiting them from the city
reading.explain: The masters send a young doctor who had come from the city to visit them.

reading.ru: Доктор, порывшись в карманах, зажигает свою спичку.
reading.question: How does the doctor provide light after Pelageya can't find a match?
options: He rummages in his pockets and lights his own match
He uses a candle he brought
He asks Yefim to light it
reading.correct: He rummages in his pockets and lights his own match
reading.explain: The doctor, searching through his pockets, lights his own match.

reading.ru: Помирать, ваше благородие, пришло время.
reading.question: What does Yefim tell the doctor about his condition?
options: That his time to die has come
That he feels much better already
That he wants to go to the hospital immediately
reading.correct: That his time to die has come
reading.explain: Yefim tells the doctor, 'Your honor, my time to die has come.'

reading.ru: Тебе нужно в больницу ехать, там тебе операцию сделают.
reading.question: What does the doctor recommend for Yefim?
options: Going to the hospital for an operation
Resting at home for a week
reading.correct: Going to the hospital for an operation
reading.explain: The doctor tells Yefim he needs to go to the hospital, where they will operate on him.

reading.ru: Это господа прислали тележку, чтобы ехать в больницу.
reading.question: How does Yefim get transported to the hospital?
options: The masters send a small cart
reading.correct: The masters send a small cart
reading.explain: The masters send a small cart so that Yefim can be taken to the hospital.

reading.ru: Ночью вправили ему, а к утру Богу души отдал.
reading.question: What does Pelageya report happened to Yefim at the hospital?
options: They operated on him at night, and by morning he had died
He was sent back home cured
reading.correct: They operated on him at night, and by morning he had died
reading.explain: Pelageya reports that they set/operated on him in the night, and by morning he had given up his soul to God.

reading.ru: Но вдруг кто-то бьет ее по затылку с такой силой, что она стукается лбом о березу.
reading.question: What jolts Varka out of her forest daydream (of grieving for her father)?
options: Someone strikes her on the back of the head so hard she hits her forehead on a birch tree
reading.correct: Someone strikes her on the back of the head so hard she hits her forehead on a birch tree
reading.explain: Someone suddenly hits her on the nape of the neck so hard that she knocks her forehead against a birch tree, waking her from the vision.

reading.ru: «Дитё плачет, а ты спишь?» Он больно треплет её за ухо, и она встряхивает головой, качает колыбель и мурлычет свою песню.
reading.question: How does the master punish Varka for seemingly falling asleep?
options: He painfully pulls her by the ear
reading.correct: He painfully pulls her by the ear
reading.explain: The master painfully yanks her by the ear after accusing her of sleeping while the child cries.

reading.ru: Подайте милостнику Христа ради, просит мать у встречных.
reading.question: What is Varka's mother doing in the beggary vision on the road?
options: Begging passersby for alms in Christ's name
reading.correct: Begging passersby for alms in Christ's name
reading.explain: In the vision, the mother begs passersby for alms for Christ's sake.

reading.ru: Нет ни шоссе, ни пелагеи, ни встречных, а стоит посреди комнатки одна только хозяйка, которая пришла покормить своего ребенка.
reading.question: What does Varka realize when she snaps out of her vision?
options: There is no highway or Pelageya — only the mistress has come to feed her own baby
She is actually back in her home village
She has fallen out of the cradle
reading.correct: There is no highway or Pelageya — only the mistress has come to feed her own baby
reading.explain: Varka realizes there is no highway, no Pelageya, no passersby — only the mistress standing in the room to feed her child.

reading.ru: Варька берет ребенка, кладет его в колыбель и опять начинает качать.
reading.question: What does Varka do once the mistress finishes feeding the baby?
options: She takes the baby, puts it back in the cradle, and resumes rocking it
She takes the baby outside for air
She hands the baby to Afanasy
She falls asleep holding the baby
reading.correct: She takes the baby, puts it back in the cradle, and resumes rocking it
reading.explain: Varka takes the child, lays it in the cradle, and begins rocking it again.

reading.ru: И вдруг калоша растет, пухнет, наполняет собой всю комнату.
reading.question: What hallucination does exhausted Varka have while cleaning a galosh?
options: The galosh grows and swells to fill the whole room
The galosh turns into a cat
The galosh starts talking to her
reading.correct: The galosh grows and swells to fill the whole room
reading.explain: In her exhaustion, Varka hallucinates the galosh growing and swelling until it fills the entire room.

reading.ru: Голову тянет к столу, картошка рябит в глазах, нож валится из рук, а возле ходит толстая, сердитая хозяйка с засученными рукавами и говорит так громко, что звенит в ушах.
reading.question: What is especially hard for Varka while peeling potatoes?
options: Her head drooping toward the table while the loud, angry mistress hovers nearby
reading.correct: Her head drooping toward the table while the loud, angry mistress hovers nearby
reading.explain: Her head droops toward the table, the potatoes blur before her eyes, and the fat, angry mistress paces nearby, speaking so loudly it rings in her ears.

reading.ru: Наконец, измучившись, она, напрягая все свои силы и зрение, глядит вверх на мигающее зеленое пятно и, прислушившись к крику, находит врага, мешающего ей жить.
reading.question: What does the exhausted Varka finally identify as the force preventing her from living/sleeping?
options: She identifies an enemy that is stopping her from living, by staring at the flickering green spot
She identifies the mistress as her enemy
She identifies the cold weather as the problem
She decides there is no real enemy
reading.correct: She identifies an enemy that is stopping her from living, by staring at the flickering green spot
reading.explain: Straining all her strength and sight, staring at the flickering green spot and listening to the crying, she finally finds the enemy that prevents her from living.

reading.ru: Этот враг — ребенок.
reading.question: Who/what does Varka conclude is her enemy?
reading.correct: The baby
reading.explain: Varka concludes that the enemy she has been searching for is the baby.

reading.ru: Ложное представление овладевает Варькой.
reading.question: What takes hold of Varka after she identifies the baby as her enemy?
options: A wave of sleepiness that passes
reading.correct: A false, delusional idea
reading.explain: A false, delusional idea takes hold of Varka's exhausted mind.

reading.ru: Задушив его, она быстро ложится на пол, смеется от радости, что ей можно спать, а через минуту спит уже крепко, как мертвая.
reading.question: What does Varka do at the very end of the story, and how does she react afterward?
options: She strangles the baby, lies on the floor laughing with joy that she can finally sleep, and falls into a deep sleep
She runs away from the house
She wakes the mistress to confess
She falls asleep still holding the crying baby
reading.correct: She strangles the baby, lies on the floor laughing with joy that she can finally sleep, and falls into a deep sleep
reading.explain: Having strangled the child, Varka quickly lies down on the floor, laughs with joy that she can now sleep, and within a minute is sleeping as soundly as the dead.
